resources.interpretation: Summed RSS counts fork-shared dataset pages repeatedly; total PSS of all training trees is about40GiB, below150GiB allocation. Initial sstat MaxRSS~204GiB is not physical ownership. No current RAM/GPU/disk blocker.

throughput.interpretation: Early pressure arms average~15.8s/epoch at4-way concurrency. Equal-throughput26-arm training projects~11.4h; velocity/joint cost and phase barriers add uncertainty. Historical evaluation+diagnostics took~4.5–5min per arm with2-way concurrency.48h appears ample absent scheduling stalls/failures; do not treat as committed ETA.

known_scheduling_caveat.finding: Queue passes Slurm-local CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 to nvidia-smi -i0, but NVML physical ordinal0 differs from allocated CUDA device. Training PIDs are on physical GPU2 / GPU-550c33a9-610b-c160-ab40-b360e328bd6e; gate queries another user GPU0.
known_scheduling_caveat.current_effect: Both queried and actual GPU free memory exceed6500MiB launch threshold, so none currently.
known_scheduling_caveat.possible_effect: Future starts may wait despite free allocated GPU if unrelated physical GPU0 free memory drops below6500MiB. Conversely gate does not measure true allocated-device capacity.
known_scheduling_caveat.handling: Preserve frozen queue source during scientific run; monitor actual UUID and gate device. No cancellation or scheduling mutation performed.

queue_failure_semantics.stage_nonzero_exit: Marks this arm failed, skips its later stages, continues other arms; final queue incomplete with nonzero exit.
queue_failure_semantics.source_change: Checks hashes before every stage launch; mismatch raises, terminates active process groups and records incomplete/source_changed.
queue_failure_semantics.data_change: Checks frozen520inputs before formal start and at completion; final mismatch invalidates completion.
queue_failure_semantics.interrupt: SIGTERM/SIGINT terminates active process groups and records interrupted arms; incomplete return.
queue_failure_semantics.resume: Existing queue state/run directories are deliberately refused; no transparent checkpoint resume/requeue support. Recovery must preserve evidence and explicitly define continuation or fresh restart.
queue_failure_semantics.finalization: Slurm14041 afterany14040 creates completion/failure evidence; reporting must validate all arms before scientific completion/workbook claims.

overall_assessment: Formal job currently progressing with all gates valid and finite recorded histories. Initial2–3 AMP gradient-overflow skips per active arm are recorded and handled by GradScaler; no fatal nonfinite loss/gradient or OOM.26-arm results are not complete.
